blockingFindings.title: R2 stream binding mismatches are not tested
blockingFindings.rationale: Without this, an implementation could ignore stdout/stderr binding validation and still pass the tests while violating R2.
blockingFindings.issue: R2 requires completion evidence to be rejected unless all stored evidence values match recomputed values, including the persisted stdout/stderr raw output metadata. The test only mutates top-level executionBinding fields and checks stream size/truncated flags on the valid artifact; it never corrupts executionBinding.stdout or executionBinding.stderr values and verifies rejection.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a spec-local assertion that mutates a stored stdout/stderr binding value that should be recomputed, then verifies validateFinalRegressionEvidence rejects the artifact.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: Without this, an implementation could ignore stdout/stderr binding validation and still pass the tests while violating R2.

blockingFindings.title: R3 explicit proceed binding mismatches are under-tested
blockingFindings.rationale: An implementation could require fields to exist but fail to compare key binding values, allowing stale or unrelated explicit proceed evidence to complete.
blockingFindings.issue: R3 requires explicit proceed to be accepted only when operator-supplied failure classification, raw output path/SHA-256, HEAD SHA, tree SHA, override rationale, residual risk, and binding all match. The test checks missing required fields and one rawOutputSha256 mismatch, but it does not verify rejection for mismatched failureClassification, rawOutputPath, headSha, or treeSha.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add mismatch cases for failureClassification, executionBinding.rawOutputPath, executionBinding.headSha, and executionBinding.treeSha in validateExplicitFinalRegressionProceed.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: An implementation could require fields to exist but fail to compare key binding values, allowing stale or unrelated explicit proceed evidence to complete.
